snippet.title: Letter From Nadine (SCREAM JAM SUBMISSION 2025) in Unreal Engine 5.6.1
snippet.description:
A story-driven puzzle thriller third-person perspective game that is immersed in darkness and mystery. Explore an unknown reality where time is precious and monsters await. Here, action gives way to introspection. A journey through the shadows in search of a light that may no longer belong to the world of the living. Among the folds of a world suspended between memory and oblivion, a young woman awakens in a dark place and tries to find her way out. Each step takes her deeper, through fragments of memories, whispers of forgotten voices, and monsters that do not harm the body but the soul. 

Through puzzles, she’ll unlock closed paths, face creatures, create new trails of light, and uncover scattered clues. She will piece together what has been broken, read between the lines of abandoned notes, and follow the thread of a story that speaks of loss, guilt, and rebirth. 

Content Warning: This game deals with sensitive topics such as depression, suicide, and trauma. We advise players to approach the experience with awareness. We hope you enjoy the game; we’ve worked hard on it. Thank you for playing.

https://geek-man-games.itch.io/letter-from-nadine (Play Letter From Nadine)
Controls 
W/A/S/D = Move 
Mouse = Look 
Left Click Mouse = Sword Attack
E = Interact 
Shift = Dash

************************
Programmer: Gabriel The Fanta Maniac 

Animators: SilfurLykos, Alejandro

3D Modelers: Alejandro (Hero Character, Shadow Creature, Sword), leslietowedesign (Death Fairy, Worm)

3D Artists: Alex, Davide

Music/Sound Effects: Yarmil

VFX Artist: leslietowedesign

Writers: Alexya, Nydera

Document Translator/Compiler (English, Spanish and Italian): Alexya

Voice Actor: insaninox

Game Lead/Level Designer: Geek Man Games
